definition: A high-visibility corporate employment contract that includes lifestyle monitoring via BCI, location tracking, and behavioral compliance clauses. Prestigious to Tier 3 aspirants, considered a gilded prison by those who have escaped one.
origin: Corporate jargon turned street slang; a sardonic inversion of the Silk Leash concept applied to mid-tier workers
usage: Mid-tier workers in Old Harbor and Lakeshore; used mockingly by Tier 1, enviously by Tier 2
example: He got a Bright Leash offer from Axiom and took it — new flat in Lakeshore, full med package, and they own every hour he's awake.
